title: 角色创建体验不佳
description: 角色创建界面设计混乱、选项受限、缺少返回功能，导致玩家难以创建满意的角色。
evidence: you can’t even see your character well because there is so much graffiti on the mirror
let us save a preset...or fix your creator
Selecting traits and features is bad because there's too much garbage to pick from.

evidence_items.quote: The character creator could definitely use some work
evidence_items.quote_zh: 角色创建器肯定还需要一些改进

evidence_items.quote: an utterly atrocious character creation screen
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一个极其糟糕的角色创建界面

evidence_items.quote: The beginning character creator.. WTF are you thinking.. crap all over and the UI isn't helping.
evidence_items.quote_zh: 开局的角色创建器……你们到底在想什么……到处都是垃圾，UI也帮不上忙。

evidence_items.quote: let us save a preset...or fix your creator
evidence_items.description: 角色创建器无法保存预设，每次需重新创建
evidence_items.quote_zh: 让我们保存一个预设……或者修复你的创建器

evidence_items.quote: you can’t even see your character well because there is so much graffiti on the mirror
evidence_items.description: 角色创建时镜子被涂鸦遮挡，看不清角色
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你甚至看不清自己的角色，因为镜子上有太多涂鸦

evidence_items.quote: Selecting traits and features is bad because there's too much garbage to pick from.
evidence_items.description: 角色创建界面选项过多且杂乱
evidence_items.quote_zh: 选择特质和特性很糟糕，因为可选的垃圾太多了。

evidence_items.quote: the only way to customize how you look is using the randomize button (as far as I can tell) and it can be quite annoying to have to keep clicking to find what you want
evidence_items.description: 角色外观只能通过随机按钮定制，很烦人
evidence_items.quote_zh: 定制你外观的唯一方法就是使用随机按钮（据我所知），而且为了找到你想要的样子不得不一直点击，这可能会非常烦人

evidence_items.quote: there were significantly limited options for character creation. Perhaps the other careers just aren't ready yet but it was aggravating to see the other options for careers and not be able to play them.
evidence_items.description: 角色创建选项显著有限，其他职业无法选择
evidence_items.quote_zh: 角色创建选项明显非常有限。也许其他职业还没准备好，但看到其他职业选项却无法游玩它们，真是令人恼火。
